I want people who are receiving treatment here, or are considering treatment here, to see this review.
From my personal experience, I brought my mother here for treatment once a week for over a month. My mother had pain in her lower back that radiated down both calves and her knees were osteoarthritis. We went to many hospitals and doctors, but she didn't improve, until we found this place (recommended by a friend).
The first time she came, she underwent a physical assessment and physiotherapy. Honestly, both my mother and I were confused about how she could get better? Because the treatment methods and procedures might seem confusing.😅
But we still believed that she would get better because everyone said that this place was definitely effective and that we should be patient, even though it was a bit confusing... Now, after more than a month of treatment at the clinic, my mother's condition has improved significantly. She says she's 70% better now. Oh, I forgot to mention, my mother is over 70 years old. Just recently, I saw her running across the road 😂 Before, she could barely walk. Before that, she walked up and down Laem Phromthep (a famous Thai beach) and said she didn't feel any pain at all. Normally, even walking normally was difficult for her. 555 It sounds unbelievable, right? If you've read this far, I want people who are deciding to seek treatment here to see this. Have faith and be patient. Things will definitely get better ❤️❤️ This is from my mom's personal experience, not a paid endorsement. Everything else was great besides the treatment; the doctors, physiotherapists, and staff were all excellent and very attentive 🥰🥰🥰🥰

I've been to the physiotherapy clinic twice. The staff is wonderful, friendly, and even has a sense of humor! Now about Dr. Vi. I've never met a doctor like him—he's a man with golden hands and a kind heart. His treatment method is unusual, but surprisingly, it works! He's a real magician! He treats people wonderfully!
The doctor provided excellent treatment and knowledge. I've had chronic lower back pain for many years, and the doctor's treatment and advice on how to manage it were very helpful.

My hair treatment helped me go from being almost unable to walk to being able to walk normally again. It's a huge improvement. You have to be open to treatment options.
Don't rush into surgery. Come get treatment here first.

I thought about not writing this review and letting it go, but I just can't say nothing when i think about people who actually need help and end up wasting their money. So, Dr. What's your response?
